method: Eight parallel readers enumerated Burp Suite's feature set per area and graded Nullock by reading its source; a second adversarial pass per area re-opened every cited file and corrected in both directions (51 verdicts changed). States are reconciled forward as features ship -- each change records the commit that made it true.
